name: Dapbiang Restaurant
why_it_matters: The single Tripadvisor-listed standalone restaurant in Mawlynnong, overlooking the village's main open square. Plain, functional dining hall with no pretence — the most-used non-homestay lunch option for day-trippers from Shillong/Cherrapunji visiting Asia's cleanest village.
insider_tip: Menu thins out after the lunch rush (1-3 PM); arrive by 12.30 PM if you want pork. Most other 'restaurants' here are homestay kitchens — Dapbiang is the only properly listed eatery.
signature_address: Mawlynnong Village Square, Mawlynnong, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya 793109
